title: Context Correction Audit Trail QA
principle: Context corrections should be visible, reversible and safe for team handoff without storing hidden conversation content.
public_repo_rule: Correction events are browser-local metadata: target, action, source IDs, source count, undo steps and timestamps only. Raw prompts, raw responses, provider secrets and paid-route approvals are not stored.

scenarios.expected: Disabling a receipt-focused memory item writes a metadata-only correction event with undo state.
Disabling a receipt-focused knowledge document or collection writes a metadata-only correction event with undo state.
Memory and Knowledge correction action bars expose an undo button when a local undoable correction exists.
The progress dashboard shows the latest local correction metadata or an empty-state note for the current workspace.
